description: Build a number collection that supports inserting values and asking whether any pair sums to a target. Example 1: add 1 and 3, then find 4 returns true. Example 2: add 3 twice, then find 6 returns true while find 3 is false. Constraints: duplicate values are permitted and a pair must use two distinct inserted elements.
intuition: A frequency map lets a target check distinguish two equal values from one occurrence.

brute_force.approach: Store all values and inspect every pair for each requested sum.

optimal.approach: Store frequencies and scan distinct values, checking the complement and multiplicity when both values are equal.

edge_cases: A value cannot pair with itself unless it was added at least twice.
Values may be negative or repeated.
